verdict.rationale: Bevy ships semver-versioned releases on crates.io (0.19.1) and publishes per-release migration guides, so its versioning is real and documented. However, it is pre-1.0 with breaking changes in every release, which community users confirm, and no documented deprecation policy appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy or deprecation windows, API stability guarantees (post-1.0 or a stable surface), and independent evidence that upgrades are non-breaking.
